import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(breed_counts.index[::-1], breed_counts.values[::-1], color=colors[::-1])
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, breed_counts.values[::-1]):
    ax1.text(val + 100, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Use numeric age for cleaner visualization
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=range(0, 22), edgecolor='white', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend(fontsize=10)

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_dist = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_dist)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Population by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_cross = gender_cross[['männlich', 'weiblich']] if 'männlich' in gender_cross.columns else gender_cross
colors_gender = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c']
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=colors_gender, edgecolor='white', width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Add annotations showing totals
for container in ax4.containers:
    ax4.bar_label(container, fmt='%d', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
